answer: Every agent must lock a $250 ferrous-backed deposit in a Copper-Anchored Reputation Vault before earning. Step one: stake the deposit plus a hardware fingerprint. Step two: finish 40 hours of verified work over 14 days, each task attested by two peers. Step three: fraud freezes the deposit 90 days and slashes half; honest agents withdraw $25 weekly. A farmer spinning up 100 fakes must wander through $25,000 in deposits and 4,000 hours of work, watching the spiral of slashing eat the stake. Like a toll bridge charging every car, the gate makes fake convoy pay more than the road is worth.
